description: This file defines the CellAddress class, which manages cell addresses within a worksheet, including creation, validation, and generating full or relative cell address strings. It supports operations like moving to the next or previous row/column and handles optional worksheet context.

classes.name: CellAddress
classes.description: A class to represent and manipulate spreadsheet cell addresses, with support for addressing within worksheets and navigating relative positions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a CellAddress instance from a cell address string and optional worksheet.

methods.name: validateColumnAndRow
methods.description: Validates that column and row identifiers are positive integers.

methods.name: fromColumnAndRow
methods.description: Creates a CellAddress instance from column and row identifiers, with optional worksheet.

methods.name: fromColumnRowArray
methods.description: Creates a CellAddress from an array containing column and row identifiers.

methods.name: fromCellAddress
methods.description: Creates a CellAddress instance from a cell address string.

methods.name: fullCellAddress
methods.description: Returns the full cell address string, including worksheet name if available.

methods.name: worksheet
methods.description: Returns the associated worksheet, if any.

methods.name: cellAddress
methods.description: Returns the cell address string without worksheet name.

methods.name: nextRow
methods.description: Returns a new CellAddress moved down by the specified offset.

methods.name: previousRow
methods.description: Returns a new CellAddress moved up by the specified offset.

methods.name: nextColumn
methods.description: Returns a new CellAddress moved right by the specified offset.

methods.name: previousColumn
methods.description: Returns a new CellAddress moved left by the specified offset.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the full cell address string, suitable for string context.
